introduction: 211 Maine helps residents locate food, housing, heating, health and other community resources. Use a specialist conversation or the online directory to identify providers serving your location.

who: Anyone can ask for a referral; you do not need an approved benefit case.
Eligibility and availability are decided by the organization offering the service.
sections.get: The service advertises confidential access around the clock and help in all languages. A resource referral identifies a possible next contact rather than approving money or housing.
sections.docs: Have your ZIP code, county and the urgent problem ready. Note any deadline and providers already contacted. These preparation details help the specialist avoid sending you back to an option that has already failed.
sections.apply:
1. Call 211, text your ZIP code to 898211, or email info@211maine.org.
  2. Use the online directory if you prefer to search.
  3. Contact the referred provider and ask about its current intake and service area.
sections.after: Keep a record of referrals and responses. Ask 211 for another option if an agency is closed, lacks funds or does not cover your location. Call 911 for an emergency rather than waiting for a referral.
